with status as (

    select * from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status

),

info as (

    select station_id, capacity, is_rack_or_corral
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information

),

latest_poll as (

    select
        max(polled_at) as max_polled_at,
        min(polled_at) as collection_start
    from status

),

ordered as (

    select
        s.station_id,
        s.last_reported_at                                            as valid_from,
        lead(s.last_reported_at) over (
            partition by s.station_id order by s.last_reported_at)    as next_report_at,
        s.bikes_available,
        s.ebikes_available,
        s.bikes_disabled,
        s.docks_available,
        s.docks_disabled,
        s.is_installed,
        s.is_renting,
        s.is_returning,
        i.capacity,
        coalesce(i.is_rack_or_corral, false)                          as is_rack_or_corral
    from status s
    left join info i on s.station_id = i.station_id

),

with_end as (

    select
        o.station_id,
        greatest(o.valid_from, lp.collection_start)                   as valid_from,
        o.valid_from < lp.collection_start                            as is_clipped,
        coalesce(o.next_report_at, lp.max_polled_at)                  as valid_to,
        o.next_report_at is null                                      as is_current,
        o.bikes_available,
        o.ebikes_available,
        o.bikes_disabled,
        o.docks_available,
        o.docks_disabled,
        o.is_installed,
        o.is_renting,
        o.is_returning,
        o.capacity,
        o.is_rack_or_corral
    from ordered o
    cross join latest_poll lp

)

select
    station_id,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0                   as duration_min,
    date_trunc('hour', valid_from)                                    as hour_utc,
    bikes_available,
    ebikes_available,
    bikes_disabled,
    docks_available,
    docks_disabled,
    capacity,
    is_installed,
    is_renting,
    is_returning,
    is_rack_or_corral,
    is_current,
    is_clipped,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0
        > 30                                  as is_stale,
    case
        when not is_installed or (not is_renting and not is_returning) then 'out_of_service'
        when bikes_available = 0 and is_renting                        then 'empty'
        when docks_available = 0 and is_returning                      then 'full'
        else 'ok'
    end                                                               as station_state
from with_end 
where valid_to > valid_from

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
where station_id is null

with all_values as (

    group by station_state

)

select *

    'empty','full','ok','out_of_service'
)

with intervals as (

    select station_id, valid_from, bikes_available, hour_utc
    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where not is_rack_or_corral
      and station_state <> 'out_of_service'

),

changes as (

    select
        station_id,
        lag(valid_from) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from)      as window_start,
        valid_from                                                              as window_end,
        hour_utc,
        bikes_available
          - lag(bikes_available) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from) as bike_change
    from intervals

)

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || to_varchar(window_end))                 as rebalancing_event_id,
    station_id,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    hour_utc,
    datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0              as window_min,
    bike_change,
    iff(bike_change > 0, 'drop_off', 'pick_up')                      as event_type
from changes
where window_start is not null
  and abs(bike_change) >= 5
  and datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0 <= 10

islands as (

with intervals as (

    select * from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals

),

lagged as (

    select
        station_id,
        valid_from,
        duration_min,
        station_state,
        is_stale,
        bikes_available,
        lag(bikes_available) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from) as prev_bikes
    from intervals

),

activity as (

    select
        station_id,
        count(*)                                                              as n_reports,
        sum(iff(prev_bikes is not null and bikes_available <> prev_bikes, 1, 0)) as n_bike_changes,
        sum(iff(station_state <> 'out_of_service' and not is_stale, duration_min, 0)) as in_service_min,
        sum(iff(station_state = 'empty' and not is_stale, duration_min, 0))   as empty_min,
        sum(iff(station_state = 'full'  and not is_stale, duration_min, 0))   as full_min,
        sum(iff(is_stale, duration_min, 0))                                   as stale_min,
        sum(duration_min)                                                     as total_min,
        min(valid_from)                                                       as first_report_at,
        max(valid_from)                                                       as last_report_at
    from lagged
    group by station_id

),

episodes as (

    select
        station_id,
        count_if(stockout_type = 'empty')                                     as empty_episodes,
        count_if(stockout_type = 'full')                                      as full_episodes,
        max(iff(stockout_type = 'empty', duration_min, null))                 as longest_empty_min
    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
    group by station_id

)

select
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    s.lat,
    s.lon,
    s.capacity,
    s.is_rack_or_corral,
    s.is_near_l,
    s.distance_to_l_km,
    s.nearest_l_station_name,
    a.n_reports,
    a.n_bike_changes,
    a.in_service_min,
    a.empty_min,
    a.full_min,
    a.empty_min / nullif(a.in_service_min, 0)                                 as pct_time_empty,
    a.full_min  / nullif(a.in_service_min, 0)                                 as pct_time_full,
    a.stale_min / nullif(a.total_min, 0)                                      as pct_time_stale,
    coalesce(e.empty_episodes, 0)                                             as empty_episodes,
    coalesce(e.full_episodes, 0)                                              as full_episodes,
    e.longest_empty_min,
    a.first_report_at,
    a.last_report_at,
    case
        when s.is_rack_or_corral                                              then 'rack_or_corral'
        when coalesce(a.n_bike_changes, 0) < 10
          or a.empty_min / nullif(a.in_service_min, 0) > 0.5
          or a.stale_min / nullif(a.total_min, 0) > 0.5
                                                                              then 'chronic_or_inactive'
        when coalesce(e.empty_episodes, 0) + coalesce(e.full_episodes, 0)
             >= 20                              then 'repeat_stockout'
        else 'normal'
    end                                                                       as station_type
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_station s
left join activity a on s.station_id = a.station_id
left join episodes e on s.station_id = e.station_id

select *

where value_field not in (
    'rack_or_corral','chronic_or_inactive','repeat_stockout','normal'

with intervals as (

    select station_id, valid_from, valid_to, station_state, is_stale, bikes_available
    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where valid_to > valid_from

),

split as (

    select
        i.station_id,
        dateadd('hour', h.value::int, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from))        as hour_utc,
        datediff(
            'second',
            greatest(i.valid_from, dateadd('hour', h.value::int, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from))),
            least(i.valid_to,      dateadd('hour', h.value::int + 1, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from)))
        ) / 60.0                                                               as minutes,
        i.station_state,
        i.is_stale,
        i.bikes_available
    from intervals i,
         lateral flatten(input => array_generate_range(
             0, datediff('hour', date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from), i.valid_to) + 1)) h

),

agg as (

    select
        station_id,
        hour_utc,
        sum(minutes)                                                           as minutes_observed,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state <> 'out_of_service', minutes, 0)) as minutes_in_service,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state = 'empty', minutes, 0))         as minutes_empty,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state = 'full',  minutes, 0))         as minutes_full,
        sum(iff(station_state = 'out_of_service', minutes, 0))                 as minutes_out_of_service,
        sum(iff(is_stale, minutes, 0))                                         as minutes_stale,
        sum(bikes_available * minutes) / nullif(sum(minutes), 0)               as avg_bikes,
        min(bikes_available)                                                   as min_bikes,
        max(bikes_available)                                                   as max_bikes
    from split
    where minutes > 0
    group by station_id, hour_utc

)

select
    md5(a.station_id || '|' || to_varchar(a.hour_utc))                         as station_hour_id,
    a.station_id,
    a.hour_utc,
    a.minutes_observed,
    a.minutes_in_service,
    a.minutes_empty,
    a.minutes_full,
    a.minutes_out_of_service,
    a.minutes_stale,
    a.minutes_empty / nullif(a.minutes_in_service, 0)                          as pct_empty,
    a.minutes_full  / nullif(a.minutes_in_service, 0)                          as pct_full,
    a.avg_bikes,
    a.min_bikes,
    a.max_bikes,

    t.date_chicago,
    t.hour_of_day,
    t.day_name,
    t.is_weekend,
    t.commute_period,

    w.temp_c,
    w.precip_mm,
    w.is_wet,
    w.is_snow,
    w.temp_band,
    w.wind_band,
    w.is_lake_wind,

    p.station_name,
    p.station_type,
    p.is_near_l,
    p.distance_to_l_km,
    p.capacity,
    p.lat,
    p.lon
from agg a
join DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_time t            on a.hour_utc = t.hour_utc
left join DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_weather w    on a.hour_utc = w.hour_utc
join DIVVY.PROD_serving.srv_station_profile p on a.station_id = p.station_id
